Frequently asked questions
Are plans priced in USD?
Yes, all plans listed on our pricing page are denominated in the United States dollar (USD).
Do I have to sign a contract?
No, you are not locked into a contract at any time during your NiceJob subscription plan. We want you to use and stay with NiceJob because you’re getting value out of our reputation marketing platform.
Can I change plans later?
Absolutely. Upgrade from Starter to Pro (or back) at any time — changes take effect on your next billing cycle.
What's my billing date?
Your billing date will be the day your 14-day trial ends or, if you sign up after the trial ends, on that date.
Will my bill be emailed to me?
Yes. You can request additional emails to be added through support.
What bill payment methods does NiceJob have?
We accept all major credit cards, including: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB, Diners Club, China UnionPay, Debit cards.
How do I know if the Starter plan or the Pro plan is right for me?
Our most popular plan is the Pro plan, but the right fit totally depends on your business.
If you're just looking to grow your reviews, the Starter plan might have everything you need (we've even got a 14 day free trial to get you started).
But if you're looking for a solution that will help you scale more quickly, the Pro plan could be the perfect fit. Along with the features in the Starter plan, you'll have access to AI replies features, Get Repeats campaigns, in-depth competitor insights, and more.
What's this mean? You'll be able to get more bookings easily by enrolling your customers in automated campaigns, enhance your services by keeping an eye on your competitor reviews, and reply to all of your valuable customers without lifting a finger.
Does NiceJob have integrations with other software?
Yes! Visit the App Marketplace to see how you can connect NiceJob to your favorite apps. From CRM and field service management to accounting and productivity – and everything in between – there’s an integration for you!
I'm a Sites customer. How much do additional landing pages and blogs cost?
If you’d like additional landing pages on your fully-managed website, there’s a one-time cost of $145 per page and an additional $15/month per page to your subscription.
If you’d like a CMS for Blogs, Services or Locations that you control, there’s a one-time $245 setup cost per CMS and an additional $15/month per CMS to your subscription.
My question isn't listed here. Where can I go for further support?
In the lower right corner of the NiceJob website and app (if you already have an account), you’ll see a blue chat icon. Click on that to ask your questions and someone from our support team will be in touch with you as soon as possible!
Alternatively, you can reach us by phone at 1-888-336-9082 and email at hello@nicejob.com , or visit the NiceJob Help Center .
